reader_title: READER — how Sunidhi decides, in order, stopping at the first failure

reader.q: Is this about my situation now?
Does it need me now — is there a clock?
Is there something I had not already thought of? A fact I already know earns nothing.
Does it name a pain I have been through, in my words?
Is there an upside, or only a warning?
Does this land on me, or on someone else?

seller_title: SELLER — how the 5% decide what to lead with

seller.q: Which capability touches what she deals with now or within a quarter?
Which of HER goals does it move?
What job would she hire us for — her progress, never our product?
Of the survivors, which scores highest against the reader's trace?

task: Run S1–S5 → three candidates. Score each against R1–R6 in order; stop at the first failure and name it. Choose the survivor. Write its subject line.
